failures.question: What was total revenue in calendar year 2010?
failures.example_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM (SELECT revenue, date_key FROM retail.fact_sales UNION ALL SELECT revenue, date_key FROM retail.fact_cancellations) AS all_transactions JOIN retail.dim_date d ON all_transactions.date_key = d.date_key WHERE d.year = 2010

failures.question: What was the cumulative (running total) revenue at the end of each month of 2011?
failures.example_sql:
WITH monthly_rev AS (
    SELECT
        d.year,
        d.month,
        SUM(val.revenue) AS monthly_revenue
    FROM (
        SELECT date_key, revenue FROM retail.fact_sales
        UNION ALL
        SELECT date_key, revenue FROM retail.fact_cancellations
    ) val
    JOIN retail.dim_date d ON val.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.year = 2011
    GROUP BY d.year, d.month
)
SELECT
    year,
    month,
    SUM(monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_revenue
FROM monthly_rev
ORDER BY month
